faq_items.question: What type of cuisine do you serve?
faq_items.answer: We serve authentic North and South Indian cuisine, featuring traditional dishes from across India including biryanis, dosas, curries, tandoori specialties, and freshly baked breads.

faq_items.question: Do you have vegetarian options?
faq_items.answer: Yes! We have extensive vegetarian options including vegetarian dosas, curries, biryanis, and more. Many of our dishes are naturally vegetarian, and we can customize dishes to meet vegetarian preferences.

faq_items.question: Do you accommodate dietary restrictions?
faq_items.answer: Yes, we accommodate various dietary needs including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and Jain dietary requirements. Please inform us of any allergies or dietary restrictions when ordering.

faq_items.question: What are your spice levels?
faq_items.answer: We offer dishes ranging from mild to very spicy. You can request your preferred spice level when ordering, and our team will customize dishes to your taste.

faq_items.question: Do you take reservations?
faq_items.answer: Yes, we accept reservations! You can book a table by calling us at +84 (028) 6291 3672 or +84 (028) 3824 5671, or through our website reservation form.

faq_items.question: Is parking available?
faq_items.answer: We don't have dedicated parking, but there are several options nearby including street parking (subject to availability) and nearby parking lots within walking distance. Public transportation is also convenient.

faq_items.question: Do you offer delivery?
faq_items.answer: Yes, we offer delivery services! Please call us at +84 (028) 6291 3672 or +84 (028) 3824 5671 to place your delivery order.

faq_items.question: Do you host events?
faq_items.answer: Yes! We host corporate events, private dining, parties, weddings, and conferences. Contact us to discuss your event needs and we'll customize menus and arrangements.

faq_items.question: What are your most popular dishes?
faq_items.answer: Our popular dishes include biryanis, dosas, tandoori specialties, North Indian curries, and South Indian breakfast items. Our chef's specials are also highly recommended!

faq_items.question: Are you wheelchair accessible?
faq_items.answer: Yes, our restaurant is wheelchair accessible. We're located on the ground floor with easy access and have accessible restrooms. Please call us if you have specific accessibility needs.
